NO waist-length hair, ponytail, twin tails, floor-length or cape-like white hair. Silver costume piping/hardware. PEARL-WHITE energy with ICY BLUE edges, RED irises, clean warm peach skin.

combatPoses: Relaxed low fighting guard, fists near ribs, both boots grounded, equipment and face visible where geometric. No attack trail.

Distinct subtle breathing fighting guard: small torso expansion, elbows ease outward, coat/vest settles, boots remain planted. Real second drawing, no canvas bobbing, no pose translation. No attack trail.
Straight-punch ANTICIPATION: striking fist drawn back beside ribs, opposite fist guarding, rear leg loaded, torso twisting before attack. No contact burst.
Straight-punch CONTACT: one fully extended fist strikes along the requested ground-plane direction, opposite fist guards torso. Compact localized knuckle burst. Foreshorten for front/back views.
Sidekick ANTICIPATION: knee chambered in front along the requested direction, other boot supporting, fists guard torso. This is martial preparation, not locomotion.
Powerful SIDEKICK CONTACT along the requested ground-plane direction: one armored boot extended, other boot grounded, compact heel trail. Foreshorten boot for front/back; draw true profile for W/E.

Spinning ROUNDHOUSE CONTACT: entire torso/hips turn naturally with extended kicking leg, both gauntlets attached and visible, compact crescent energy trail. Preserve the requested overall camera view; no flat sprite rotation.
Crouched UPPERCUT ANTICIPATION: weight low, both boots grounded, one gauntlet lowered, other protecting torso, poised to rise.
Rising aerial UPPERCUT CONTACT: fist thrusts upward, knee raised, entire body airborne, compact rising energy trail. Preserve eight different camera orientations, no face in north.

Airborne descending AXE-KICK: one leg raised, the opposite armored boot striking diagonally downward in requested ground-plane direction, fists guarding. Entire body airborne and intact, short controlled trail.
DOUBLE-FIST GROUND SLAM contact: wide low crouch, both gauntlets on ground ahead of body, head upright where visible, compact form-color burst. Natural back/side occlusion in each view.

Settling RECOVERY to low fighting guard: torso and arms soften after strike, coat/vest settles, both boots grounded. Distinct from initial guard while preserving anatomy/camera. No large contact trail.
